### 7. Pre-Publish Checks (Release Guard)

[`scripts/check-commit.js`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/ant-design-ant-design@2f623fe5536395bbb4dfa694fae6dbf2042d9025/-/blob/scripts/check-commit.js) is invoked before publishing (`npm run check-commit`). It verifies:
1. The current `package.json` version does not already exist on the npm registry (`registry.npmjs.org/antd`).
2. The current branch is `master` (or `4.0-prepare`) unless the version is a pre-release (`-alpha.`, `-beta.`, `-rc.`, `-experimental.`).
3. No uncommitted file changes remain in the working tree.
4. The `origin` remote URL includes `ant-design/ant-design`.

`prepublishOnly` in `package.json` runs `antd-tools run guard`. `postpublish` runs `scripts/post-script.js`.

TypeScript demos are separately validated by [`scripts/check-ts-demo.js`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/ant-design-ant-design@2f623fe5536395bbb4dfa694fae6dbf2042d9025/-/blob/scripts/check-ts-demo.js): it extracts all ` ```tsx ` blocks from demo `.md` files, writes them as temporary `.tsx` files, and runs `tsc` over them.
